python_code:
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.planning import get_plan_serializer
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Scene_Asset_Query_Generate(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_scene_asset_query_generate"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("scene_plan_json", "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("zone_filter",     "string", widget_type="text",     default="")
        self.add_input("required_only",   "bool",   widget_type="checkbox", default=False)
        self.add_output("queries_json",    "string")
        self.add_output("query_count",     "int")
        self.add_output("required_count",  "int")
        self.add_output("categories_json", "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        plan_json = inputs.get("scene_plan_json", "") or ""
        if not plan_json.strip():
            self.log_error("No scene_plan_json provided.")
            return {"queries_json": "[]", "query_count": 0, "required_count": 0,
                    "categories_json": "[]", "exec_out": True}
        zone_filter  = (inputs.get("zone_filter") or "").strip()
        required_only = bool(inputs.get("required_only") or False)
        try:
            plan = get_plan_serializer().from_json(plan_json)
            queries = plan.asset_queries
            if zone_filter:
                queries = [q for q in queries if q.zone == zone_filter]
            if required_only:
                queries = [q for q in queries if q.priority == "required"]
            required_count = sum(1 for q in queries if q.priority == "required")
            categories = sorted(set(q.category for q in queries if q.category))
            self.log_info(f"Asset queries: {len(queries)} total, {required_count} required, {len(categories)} categories")
            return {
                "queries_json":    json.dumps([q.to_dict() for q in queries]),
                "query_count":     len(queries),
                "required_count":  required_count,
                "categories_json": json.dumps(categories),
                "exec_out": True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Asset query generation failed: {exc}")
            return {"queries_json": "[]", "query_count": 0, "required_count": 0,
                    "categories_json": "[]", "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Scene_Asset_Query_Generate
